U_0x00911B: A <Personal Trooper> heavily upgraded from the PTX-001 Gespenst; the first unit born of the 'Halloween Plan,' a Gespenst enhancement scheme by Gilliam Yager and Kai Kitamura. <Mao Industries>' latest technology rebuilt it from the frame up, replacing nearly all armor. A back-mounted <Tesla Drive> flight unit gives agility rivaling the newest machines, plus the powerful Mega Buster Cannon beam weapon.
U_0x009436: A captured Lion, the <DC>'s mass-production <Armored Module>, with upgraded weapons and armor. Spare <Personal Trooper> parts from the Huckebein, Gespenst and Alt Eisen are used; its arms are <Personal Trooper> parts, and folding leg blades let it handle the close combat the Lion was poor at. A stopgap between <Personal Trooper> and <Armored Module>, but its potential is high.
U_0x009718: Under Dr. Marion Radom's plan, Tasuku Shinguji upgraded the Guarlion Custom flown by his lover, Leona Garstein. The latest <Personal Trooper> tech and a <Tesla Drive> boost mobility and firepower, plus the <T-LINK System>. As on the Guarlion, shoulder force-field inductors fix induction-heated metal particles ahead of it, wrapped and extended by a telekinetic field to strike foes.
U_0x009A12: An upgraded Giganscudo. TGC joints from the Grungust series are used at every joint, and the Sees Shield Units became Sees Anchor Units, improving melee ability. An improved Gravicon System lets it deploy a G-Territory, further raising defense. The Duro (Italian for 'hard') conversion plan was drawn up by Dr. Marion Radom; the unit is nicknamed 'Gandro.'
U_0x009CE6: An <Armored Module> for space flight and vacuum work, from interstellar program <Project TD>. Newest of the Series 77, based on the earlier Asterion AX. Twin flank-mounted <Tesla Drives> give it mobility no other <Armored Module> can match. It shifts between the flight-use Cruise Figure (CF) and work-use Doll Figure (DF). Against hostile deep-space life it mounts the gravity-controlled cannon 'G Accel Driver' and 'CTM' tactical missiles.
U_0x00A05A: A high-mobility <Armored Module> from interstellar flight program <Project TD>. Newest of Series 77, based on the Calion. Two compact <Tesla Drives> give speed and agility beyond its sister, the Altairlion.
